column1: # ui field batch 4: SelectionPanelBase and ResultBanner (15 fields).
# SelectionPanelBase. The constructor builds three mutually exclusive sub-panels and the shared
# a(String, Zx6) configuration method dispatches between them, so their roles follow from the
# arguments UnitPanelBase passes in (text, unitType.canCarryAircraft(), unit.H() = isHostedAuto,
#   bl (canCarryAircraft)  -> carrierPanel (k) with carrierHighlight (l) shown per isHostedAuto;
#   bl3 (isImmobile)       -> buildingPanel (m) with buildingHighlight (n) shown per hasMoveTarget;
#   otherwise              -> mobilePanel (o), whose actionButton (p, data 10000) is enabled per the
# j is the "this instance has the extra panels" flag: set true for every subclass except
# SingleUnitPanel, and it is exactly what gates the three-way dispatch above.
# The shared members: domains (a) and layers (b) are the Domain/Layer arrays the strength bars are
# built for, unitCommander (e) is the command interface the panels call, titleLabel (h) is what the
# configuration method writes the unit name into, and infoContainer (i) holds the per-unit rows.
# Left unnamed: c/d (per-unit-type TextureRegions at atlas rows 1101/1150 - written in the
# constructor but never read) and f/g (the two Image arrays sized by the domain count, whose
# attack/defense split no call site distinguishes).
# ResultBanner: victory (a) is what setVictory/isVictory toggle and what picks the WON or LOST
# region of bannerImage (c, the 287x68 / 275x68 atlas region); separatorImage (b) is the 1x68 strip
# that resize() stretches to the screen width.
